question: Who may place or release a legal hold, and who adopts the retention policy?
decision: Authorized union records officers and counsel place/release legal holds under a logged independent approval rule. The executive board or equivalent adopts a record-class/jurisdiction retention schedule; seven years after case closure is at most a proposed staging default, not a universal destruction permission. Legal holds, appeals, provincial limitations, collective-agreement and privacy obligations prevail. Retention jobs must honor holds and record deletions.
originalProposedDecision: Officers (and counsel) place and release legal holds; the executive board adopts the retention policy. Platform default: 7 years after case closure.
independentApprovalScope: decision wording / platform baseline only; NOT independent security or operational testing
